content.title: Contact-Triggered Corridor Escalation | Hand Signal, Pulse, Residue-Free Exit
content.summary: Establish a baseline corridor walk, preview capability with one hand cue, escalate contact-born pulses, and finish on the same residue-free route.

quick_start.input_format: The baseline walk and crowd geography are established first. + A small hand signal previews the capability. + Each pulse begins at physical contact. + Escalation moves along one corridor direction. + The final state returns to the original walk with no residual glow.
quick_start.recommended_input: Follow an adult night-shift technician walking frontally through a crowded maintenance tunnel. A low brace and shoulder contact trigger the first short magnetic pulse. After the obstruction clears, the same technician resumes the original walk as the cyan light fades completely.
required_anchors: The baseline walk and crowd geography are established first.
A small hand signal previews the capability.
Escalation moves along one corridor direction.
The final state returns to the original walk with no residual glow.

applicable_scope: Establish a baseline corridor walk, preview capability with one hand cue, escalate contact-born pulses, and finish on the same residue-free route.
